answer: Stop sybils with a sonnet copper garden: an agent bonds one garden bed. Each cycle it inks one sonnet in copper on its garden slate; verifiers match the sonnet's rhyme scheme to the garden chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 gardens at 19x: one sonnet rhymes once in one garden, its scheme set by that bed alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents ink once, keep rights.
